title: risk: sig_len_max==0 sentinel undocumented in wp11_key_obj_t
description: C_Sign() uses obj->sig_len_max == 0 as a sentinel meaning 'unknown, fall back to 512'. This invariant is not documented in the struct definition. A contributor who sets sig_len_max=0 explicitly (thinking it means 'zero-length') will inadvertently enable the 512-byte fallback for all operations, potentially returning wrong size hints to callers. Fix: add a comment in the struct field: 'zero means unknown (use fallback); set by login or key-load path'. Add a named constant WP11_SIG_LEN_UNKNOWN = 0 to make intent explicit at assignment sites.
